title: Teen Drop-Out Launches AI Missile Startup
excerpt: A 16-year-old entrepreneur leaves high school to start an artificial intelligence-powered missile company backed by a Silicon Valley accelerator.
body_html:
A 16-year-old entrepreneur has chosen to leave high school in order to establish a new startup focused on building artificial intelligence-powered missiles.

The young founder's venture has already secured backing from a Silicon Valley accelerator, according to recent reports highlighting the unconventional career path and the intersection of youth entrepreneurship with advanced defense technology.
